Roles and permissions

Which role grants which permission. Access is fail-closed: an operation, command or page needs the one permission it names.
Permission reader clerk supervisor
loans.read yes
loans.write yes
loans.renew yes

Name description
loans.read /permissions/loans.read See loans.
loans.write /permissions/loans.write Change loans.
loans.renew /permissions/loans.renew Renew loans.

Roles /roles

Name description permissions
reader /roles/reader Sees loans. loans.read
clerk /roles/clerk Changes loans. loans.write
supervisor /roles/supervisor Renews loans. loans.renew

Separation of duties /separationOfDuties

read-write-renew /separationOfDuties/read-write-renew

Roles never given to one person: reader with clerk with supervisor.

Insight: Renewing a loan one has lent and can see hides an overdue copy.

description
Nobody both reads, changes and renews loans.
permissions

loans.read, loans.write, loans.renew

cardinality
3
